sources.title: NeurIPS SongMAE: Fine-Grained Syllable Discovery in Birdsong Using ...
sources.snippet: Self-supervised bioacoustic encoders have been used for species classification but so far have not addressed syllable-level structure in birdsong. We introduce SongMAE, a compact MAE-ViT (Masked Autoencoder Vision Transformer) that operates on mel spectrograms with 2 ms temporal resolution. SongMAE is pre-trained with masked spectrogram reconstruction on diverse bioacoustic recordings. Despite ...
